text:
lee: heads upinvoice-preview shows ~2% uptick for a subset of EU tenants; looks correlated with last night's ingest connector tweak
nadia: saw an error spike in metering-consumer logs at 23:58 UTC, lots of out-of-order enqueues
carlos: that was the ack change (ack_on_commit) + retry buffer patch. i moved fingerprint calc to commit path in a rush
lee: ah, so dedupe_id sometimes missing on first enqueue -> later commit creates it and system double-counts in preview windows
nadia: short-term mitigation idea: exclude events with ingest_latency_ms > 30_000 from preview aggregation. keeps final invoices accurate, just hides noisy preview items
carlos: can ship hotfix to preview aggregator, will emit metric preview_filter_count and canary to 5% tenants
adia: long-term fix: materialize dedupe_id at proxy/enqueue time or compute deterministic fingerprint earlier. also need migration notes for Dedicated installs
adia: console change: add preview_confidence score + tooltip explaining filtering so PM/Finance don't panic
lee: create alert: billing.preview_delta > 1% for 15m -> #eng-oncall + #finance-watch. finance-bot add runbook link
infra-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/preview-filter -> staging
infra-bot: deploy succeeded to staging (build 5621)
carlos: staged canary on 5% tenants, monitoring preview_delta and late_event_rate
lee: also add nightly reconciliation job to emit invoice_correction_estimate for transparency
finance-bot: reminder: preview filters must never change final invoices. include note in runbook and post to #product
nadia: i'll start fingerprint-refactor PR and integration tests for reorder/dedupe cases
lee: summary: hotfix in staging, fingerprint refactor underway, console + alerts + reconciliation job planned. will close thread after canary looks stable
